top_signals.title: Diesel Crisis Threatens to Outlast the Middle East War
top_signals.summary: The outlook for the Middle East war remains grim, the U.S. just threatened Iran with the “toughest sanctions in history,” and the world is running out of stored fuels. To make matters worse, refining capacity is down considerably, and even if the outlook for the war suddenly changed and the U.S. and Iran made peace, the fuel squeeze will last for months—and so will its adverse effects on the global economy. top_signals.title: 53,000 Fukushima nuclear plant workers receive high radiation doses
top_signals.summary: The workers hit the level of 5 millisieverts per year, a threshold for determining whether those with leukemia are eligible for compensation benefits.
